round2.station_type_rule: Automatic or manual: the station's live sensors if it has any (it reports itself), else the Bureau's December 2025 SLS, else the 2024 KMZ's network column (ALERT, TELEMETER, AWS automatic; ROT, SYNOP read by hand). Water level or rain: a water level station if its sensors or the SLS have a river gauge, else whichever of sensors, SLS and KMZ says. Only where the station has no type; a station with no evidence of either stays untyped.
